title: Elite: Crown of Cinders: Threshold Sign
description: Crown of Cinders unfolds across cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame, pushing a one active Titan Infernal Dominion Titan to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon. Appearance rule: Infernal Dominion is the source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchies, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
lore: This mission treats Infernal Dominion as the origin behind hell, demonology, and infernal contract myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchies, ash velvet, hellfire clauses instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame; source-culture appearance layer: black iron courts, volcanic glass aisles, ember chain channels, debtor seal floors, contract dais, obsidian throne shadows; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Goetic chain-crown blades, volcanic glass debtor plates, blood-wax infernal ledger cores, chain-lien reversals
